metadata.question: Were the water levels in Lake Kariba in December, 2019 higher than the water levels seen in December, 2018?

data.raw_code: To answer this question about Lake Kariba water levels, I need to: 1. Use water detection/water level data - JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1 SAR for water detection 2. Compare December 2018 vs December 2019 3. Focus on Lake Kariba region (Zambia/Zimbabwe border) 4. Use water occurrence or water classification to estimate water extent/levels I'll use the JRC Global Surface Water dataset which provides monthly water classification. For Lake Kariba, I can compare the water occurrence between the two Decembers. Strategy: - Use JRC Global Surface Water Monthly History - Filter for December 2018 and December 2019 - Calculate water area/extent for each period - Compare the two values Data quality checks: - Check if collections have data - Check if valid pixels exist after processing - Validate the results are reasonable ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeKariba = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[26.5, -17.8], [28.5, -17.8], [28.5, -16.0], [26.5, -16.0], [26.5, -17.8]] ]); // 2. Data Acquisition - JRC Global Surface Water Monthly History const dec2018 = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_3/MonthlyHistory') .filterDate('2018-12-01', '2019-01-01') .filterBounds(lakeKariba); const dec2019 = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_3/MonthlyHistory') .filterDate('2019-12-01', '2020-01-01') .filterBounds(lakeKariba); // Check collection sizes const count2018 = dec2018.size().getInfo(); const count2019 = dec2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 December Images: ${count2018}`); console.log(`2019 December Images: ${count2019}`); if (count2018 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the monthly images const img2018 = dec2018.first(); const img2019 = dec2019.first(); // Water detection: values 2 (permanent water) and 3 (seasonal water) const waterMask2018 = img2018.eq(2).or(img2018.eq(3)); const waterMask2019 = img2019.eq(2).or(img2019.eq(3)); // Calculate water area for each year const waterArea2018 = waterMask2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeKariba, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('water').getInfo(); const waterArea2019 = waterMask2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeKariba, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('water').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const pixelCount2018 = waterMask2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeKariba, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('water').getInfo(); const pixelCount2019 = waterMask2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeKariba, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('water').getInfo(); console.log(`2018 Water Area: ${waterArea2018} (Pixels: ${pixelCount2018})`); console.log(`2019 Water Area: ${waterArea2019} (Pixels: ${pixelCount2019})`); if (pixelCount2018 === 0 || pixelCount2019 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Validate results if (waterArea2018 === null || waterArea2019 === null || isNaN(waterArea2018) || isNaN(waterArea2019) || waterArea2018 < 0 || waterArea2019 < 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare water levels - higher water area indicates higher water levels const waterHigherIn2019 = waterArea2019 > waterArea2018; console.log(`Water area difference: ${waterArea2019 - waterArea2018}`); if (waterHigherIn2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
